caption: The drawing shows a rectangular panel that appears slightly tilted and is filled with vertical stripes of alternating colors—primarily gold, gray, and white—each stripe featuring repeating floral and organic patterns in dark gray or black ink. The top and bottom edges of the panel are bordered by horizontal bands decorated with a scrolling vine and floral motif, incorporating yellow flowers at regular intervals. Each vertical stripe within the panel contains symmetrical, stylized designs resembling flowers, leaves, and abstract natural forms, repeating at regular intervals along the length of each stripe. The gold and gray colors alternate throughout the panel, and the lines and ornamental patterns are outlined in black. The panel's border also has an inner gold outline, separating the decorative border from the patterned stripes. The background of the overall image is a plain, off-white or light beige color.
title: Retablo
